translations.zh: 蔡珍，彰德安陽人。
translations.literal: Cai Zhen was a native of Anyang in Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: Cai Zhen was from Anyang in Zhangde.

translations.zh: 父興，幼隸軍籍，從宗王口溫不花出征，權管軍百戶。
translations.literal: His father Xing, while young, was entered on the military register; he followed Prince Kouwenbuhua on campaign and served as acting hundred-household army commander.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xing entered the military rolls as a youth, followed Prince Kouwenbuhua on campaign, and served as acting hundred-household army commander.

translations.zh: 興告老，以珍代之。
translations.literal: When Xing retired, Zhen replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xing retired, Zhen took his place.

translations.zh: 珍素驍勇。
translations.literal: Zhen had always been fierce and brave.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was known for his courage in battle.

translations.zh: 歲戊午，從憲宗攻宋合州釣魚山。
translations.literal: In the wuwu year he followed Xianzong in attacking the Song position at Mount Diaoyu in Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In wuwu he followed Xianzong in the attack on Mount Diaoyu at Hezhou.

translations.zh: 中統元年，從世祖征阿里不哥。
translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong he followed Shizu in campaigning against Ariq Böke.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhongtong he followed Shizu against Ariq Böke.

translations.zh: 三年，從征李璮。
translations.literal: In the third year he joined the campaign against Li Tan.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he took part in the campaign against Li Tan.

translations.zh: 後從鎮襄陽，徇安慶，攻五河，所至有功。
translations.literal: Later he followed in garrisoning Xiangyang, raided Anqing, and attacked Wuhe; wherever he went he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: He later helped garrison Xiangyang, raided Anqing, and attacked Wuhe, distinguishing himself wherever he served.

translations.zh: 南方平，遂入備宿衞。
translations.literal: When the south was pacified, he then entered service in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: After the south was pacified he entered the palace guard.

translations.zh: 十四年，授忠顯校尉、管軍總把，尋命權千戶。
translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he was appointed Loyal and Manifest Guardsman and troop commander, and soon was ordered to serve as acting thousand-household.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he was made Loyal and Manifest Guardsman and troop commander, and soon received an acting thousand-household appointment.

translations.zh: 是年冬，扈駕駐黑城。
translations.literal: That winter he escorted the imperial carriage when the court halted at Heicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he escorted the imperial retinue when the court halted at Heicheng.

translations.zh: 珍遣兵士儲芻藁，築土室，軍府賴其用。
translations.literal: Zhen sent soldiers to store fodder and build earthen shelters; the army headquarters relied on this provision.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen had his men store fodder and build earthen shelters, supplies on which the army headquarters came to rely.

translations.zh: 道遇凍者，必扶入密室溫煦之。
translations.literal: If he met someone frozen on the road, he always helped him into a warm room to thaw.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he met someone frozen on the road, he brought the man into a warm room to thaw.

translations.zh: 軍糧必為撙節，不使頓絕以致饑困。
translations.literal: Army grain was always rationed so that supplies did not suddenly run out and cause hunger and hardship.
translations.idiomatic: He always rationed army grain so that supplies never ran out abruptly and left the men hungry.

translations.zh: 十五年，充本衞都鎮撫。
translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he served as commander of pacification of this guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year he became commander of pacification of his guard.

translations.zh: 十七年，陞忠武校尉、中衞親軍總把，俄改屬後衞，賜銀符。
translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Loyal Martial Guardsman and chief commander of the Central Guard's personal troops; soon he was transferred to the Rear Guard and granted a silver tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year he was promoted to Loyal Martial Guardsman and chief commander of the Central Guard's personal troops, then transferred to the Rear Guard and granted a silver tally.

translations.zh: 時白海初建行營，命珍督役，卒事，民不知擾，雖草木無纖介損。
translations.literal: At that time Baihai was first establishing a traveling camp; Zhen was ordered to supervise the labor. When the work was finished, the people knew no disturbance, and not even a blade of grass or tree was harmed.
translations.idiomatic: When Baihai was first establishing a traveling camp, Zhen was ordered to supervise the work. When it was finished the people had scarcely noticed, and not a blade of grass or leaf had been harmed.

translations.zh: 帝臨幸，問其故，近臣以蔡珍號令嚴肅為對，帝嘉之，賞以鈔若干。
translations.literal: When the Emperor visited in person and asked the reason, a close attendant answered that Cai Zhen's orders were strict and severe; the Emperor commended this and rewarded him with a certain amount of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor visited and asked why, a close attendant replied that Cai Zhen's orders were strict and severe. The Emperor praised him and rewarded him with paper money.

translations.zh: 二十一年，改授膠東海道都漕運司丁壯萬戶府都鎮撫。
translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was reassigned as commander of pacification of the Jiaodong Sea Route Directorate of Grain Transport's ten-thousand-household office for able-bodied men.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was reassigned as commander of pacification of the Jiaodong Sea Route grain transport directorate's ten-thousand-household office for able-bodied men.

translations.zh: 二十七年，進後衞親軍千戶，佩金符。
translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to thousand-household of the Rear Guard's personal troops and wore the gold tally.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was promoted to thousand-household of the Rear Guard's personal troops and received the gold tally.

translations.zh: 元貞元年，進階武略。
translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanzhen he was advanced in rank to Martial Strategy.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yuanzhen he was advanced in rank to Martial Strategy.

translations.zh: 俄告老而歸，子恕襲。
translations.literal: Soon he retired on grounds of age and returned home; his son Shu inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he retired and returned home, and his son Shu succeeded him.
